title: Image Resizer
text: Change dimensions of image in pixel stream, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations; {Input height and width} sets the dimensions of active frame in input stream, {Input size source} sets the source of input active frame, {Maximum input height and width} sets the active frame size that accommodates the largest anticipated input size, {Output height and width} sets the dimensions of active frame in output stream, {Output size source} sets the source of input active frame, {Maximum output height and width} sets the active frame size that accommodates the largest anticipated output size, {Insert horizontal blanking} adds invalid cycles between active lines, {Minimum output horizontal blanking} sets the number of inactive cycles to insert between output, {Interpolation method} sets the method of interpolating pixel values, {Perform antialiasing on downscale} applies antialiasing filter before resizing, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow action for internal fixed-point, {Coefficients} sets the interpolation filter coefficients data type and {Output}. Values come from the instance.
